text: The ESA sample(s) of the rear lamp submitted for type approval shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
test_case: Inspect the submitted samples and confirm the trade name/mark and type designation are present, legible and survive a rub test.

text: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval only if they are obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and if they are identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.
quote: ESA which are brought to the market as replacement parts do not need a type approval if they are obviously marked as a replacement part
condition: The lamp is sold as a replacement part without its own R10 type approval.
test_case: Check that the replacement part carries an identification number and is identical to, and from the same manufacturer as, the original equipment.

text: In case the ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128 granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37
condition: The ESA is (part of) a light source (e.g. replaceable LED light source).
test_case: Verify the application includes either an R37/R99/R128 approval number or a Technical Service report confirming non-interchangeability.

text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
test_case: Inspect the production lamp and confirm the R10 approval mark per paragraph 5.3 is affixed.

text: The approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
test_case: Inspect the mark and confirm a circle enclosing 'E' followed by the approving country's number.

text: The approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle
test_case: Inspect the mark and confirm '10R-' followed by the approval number is placed to the right of the circle.

text: The ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle
test_case: Review design and EMC test results confirming the lamp ESA meets R10 requirements in normal conditions of use.

text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
test_case: Confirm test reports exist covering radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity for the lamp ESA.

text: Before testing, a test plan shall be prepared in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.
quote: the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s)
test_case: Check that a test plan exists listing operating modes (position, stop, reversing), monitored functions, pass/fail criteria and intended emissions.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control electronics) making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Review the test report to confirm broadband radiated emission was measured per Annex 7 on a representative lamp sample.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control electronics) making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Measure broadband emission per Annex 7 from 30 to 75 MHz; all values must be below the logarithmically decreasing 62 to 52 dBµV/m limit.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
quote: 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control electronics) making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Measure broadband emission per Annex 7 from 75 to 400 MHz; all values must be below the 52 to 63 dBµV/m limit of Appendix 6.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA broadband limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control electronics) making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Measure broadband emission per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz; all values must be below 63 dBµV/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/control electronics) making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Compare the Annex 7 broadband measurement curve to the limit line; pass if all values are below the limit.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
condition: The lamp contains an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz (otherwise deemed to comply per 6.10.1).
test_case: Review the test report to confirm narrowband radiated emission was measured per Annex 8 on a representative lamp.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz.
quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
condition: The lamp contains an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz.
test_case: Measure narrowband emission per Annex 8 from 30 to 75 MHz; all values must be below the 52 to 42 dBµV/m limit.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the ESA narrowband limits shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
quote: 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz
condition: The lamp contains an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz.
test_case: Measure narrowband emission per Annex 8 from 75 to 400 MHz; all values must be below the 42 to 53 dBµV/m limit of Appendix 7.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA narrowband limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
condition: The lamp contains an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz.
test_case: Measure narrowband emission per Annex 8 from 400 to 1,000 MHz; all values must be below 53 dBµV/m.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
condition: The lamp contains an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz.
test_case: Compare the Annex 8 narrowband measurement to the limit line; pass if all values are below the limit.

text: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
quote: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10
condition: The lamp is switched, contains switches or includes an inductive load (otherwise deemed to comply per 6.10.5).
test_case: Perform ISO 7637-2 transient emission test per Annex 10 and record pulse amplitudes against Table 1.

text: For ESAs intended for vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed transient conducted emission pulse amplitude shall be +75 V for positive polarity and -100 V for negative polarity as given in Table 1.
quote: Maximum allowed pulse amplitude for Polarity of pulse amplitude Vehicles with 12 V systems Vehicles with 24 V systems Positive +75 V
condition: The lamp is switched, contains switches or includes an inductive load; the lamp is for a 12 V system.
test_case: Measure transient emission per ISO 7637-2; pass if positive pulses ≤ +75 V and negative pulses ≥ -100 V.

text: For ESAs intended for vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed transient conducted emission pulse amplitude shall be +150 V for positive polarity and -450 V for negative polarity as given in Table 1.
quote: Positive +75 V +150 V Negative -100 V -450 V
condition: The lamp is switched, contains switches or includes an inductive load; the lamp is for a 24 V system.
test_case: Measure transient emission per ISO 7637-2; pass if positive pulses ≤ +150 V and negative pulses ≥ -450 V.

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
condition: The lamp performs immunity related functions (e.g. stop/position signalling) and contains electronics making it an ESA (otherwise deemed to comply per 6.10.3).
test_case: Review test report to confirm radiated immunity testing per a method chosen from Annex 9.

text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a and the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
condition: The lamp performs immunity related functions and contains electronics making it an ESA.
test_case: Verify the applied test levels in the Annex 9 test report match Table 2a and Table 2b for the chosen method.

text: For the stripline method, the ESA shall be tested at 60 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 50 V/m over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
quote: Stripline TEM cell BCI ALSE Reverberation chamber Frequency range below 2 GHz 20 to 400 MHz
condition: The lamp performs immunity related functions and the stripline method is chosen.
test_case: Stripline test per Annex 9: confirm 60 V/m over >90% and ≥50 V/m over all of 20-400 MHz with no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: For the TEM cell method, the ESA shall be tested at 75 V/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 200 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 62,5 V/m over the whole 20 to 200 MHz frequency band, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
quote: Test level below 2 GHz 60 V/m 75 V/m 60 mA 30 V/m 21 V/m
condition: The lamp performs immunity related functions and the TEM cell method is chosen.
test_case: TEM cell test per Annex 9: confirm 75 V/m over >90% and ≥62.5 V/m over all of 20-200 MHz with no degradation.

text: For the BCI method, the ESA shall be tested at 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 400 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 400 MHz frequency band, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
quote: Test level below 2 GHz 50 V/m 62,5 V/m 50 mA 25 V/m 18 V/m
condition: The lamp performs immunity related functions and the BCI method is chosen.
test_case: BCI test per Annex 9: confirm 60 mA over >90% and ≥50 mA over all of 20-400 MHz with no degradation.

text: For the ALSE method, the ESA shall be tested at 30 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole 80 to 2,000 MHz frequency band, and at 10 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 8 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
quote: Frequency range above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 2,000 to 6,000 MHz 2,000 to 6,000 MHz Test level above 2 GHz
condition: The lamp performs immunity related functions and the ALSE method is chosen.
test_case: ALSE test per Annex 9: confirm 30/25 V/m (80-2000 MHz) and 10/8 V/m (2-6 GHz) levels applied with no degradation.

text: For the reverberation chamber method, the ESA shall be tested at 21 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 18 V/m over the whole LUF to 2,000 MHz frequency band, and at 7 V/m in over 90 per cent and a minimum of 6 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band, as given in Tables 2a and 2b.
quote: Test level above 2 GHz Not applicable Not applicable Not applicable 8 V/m 6 V/m
condition: The lamp performs immunity related functions and the reverberation chamber method is chosen.
test_case: Reverberation chamber test per Annex 9: confirm 21/18 V/m (LUF-2000 MHz) and 7/6 V/m (2-6 GHz) with no degradation.

text: While tests are performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
condition: The lamp performs immunity related functions and contains electronics making it an ESA.
test_case: Monitor lamp light output (stop/position/reversing) during Annex 9 exposure; pass if no degradation of immunity related functions.

text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2
condition: The lamp contains electronics making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Confirm the test report covers starting profile and pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b per Annex 10 at Table 3a/3b levels.

text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
condition: The lamp is an ESA that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12 V/24 V starter motor.
test_case: Check the starting profile results are classified using ISO 16750-1 functional status classes.

text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
condition: The lamp contains electronics making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Check pulse test results are classified using ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses (for ESA which shall be operational during engine start phases) C (for other ESA)
condition: The lamp is for a 12 V system and could be installed in a vehicle with an ICE started by a starter motor.
test_case: Apply ISO 16750-2 starting profile level II, 10 pulses; verify required functional status class (B/C/D) is met.

text: For the 24 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
quote: Starting profile is only applicable to ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor.
condition: The lamp is for a 24 V system and could be installed in a vehicle with an ICE started by a starter motor.
test_case: Apply ISO 16750-2 starting profile level II, 10 pulses at 24 V; verify required functional status class is met.

text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses III III
condition: The lamp contains electronics making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Apply 500 pulses 1 at -75 V (12 V) / -450 V (24 V); pass if FPSC III achieved.

text: For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 2a +37 V +37 V 500 pulses I III
condition: The lamp contains electronics making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Apply 500 pulses 2a at +37 V; pass if FPSC I for immunity related functions and III otherwise.

text: For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 2b +10 V +20 V 10 pulses II III
condition: The lamp contains electronics making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Apply 10 pulses 2b at +10 V (12 V) / +20 V (24 V); pass if FPSC II for immunity related functions and III otherwise.

text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 3a -112 V -150 V 1 h I III
condition: The lamp contains electronics making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Apply pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V) / -150 V (24 V) for 1 h; pass if FPSC I for immunity related functions and III otherwise.

text: For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
quote: 3b +75 V +150 V 1 h I III
condition: The lamp contains electronics making it an ESA within the scope of UN R10.
test_case: Apply pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V) for 1 h; pass if FPSC I for immunity related functions and III otherwise.

text: Where the ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8.
quote: does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply
condition: The lamp electronics contain no oscillator operating above 9 kHz.
test_case: Review schematic/BOM for oscillators >9 kHz; if none, narrowband compliance is deemed.

text: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.
quote: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply
condition: The lamp has no immunity related functions.
test_case: Review function analysis; if no immunity related functions, radiated immunity compliance is deemed.

text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission
condition: The lamp is not switched, contains no switches or includes no inductive load.
test_case: Review circuit design for switches/inductive loads; if absent, transient emission compliance is deemed.

text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
quote: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
test_case: Check the broadband emission test report confirms the lamp ESA was measured per the Annex 7 method.

text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dBµV/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6; in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dBµV/m.
quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dBµV/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
test_case: Measure broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 1,000 MHz and verify all values are below the 62-52 / 52-63 / 63 dBµV/m limit line.

text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dBµV/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
test_case: Compare measured broadband emission values in dBµV/m against the paragraph 7.10.2.1 limits; pass if all are below.

text: In the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the broadband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz 75-400 MHz 400-1,000 MHz E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30)
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver) and is not exempted as a passive ESA.
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions at 30-75 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth per Annex 7; pass if all values are below 62 - 25.13 log(F/30) dBµV/m.

text: In the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the broadband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz 75-400 MHz 400-1,000 MHz E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75)
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver) and is not exempted as a passive ESA.
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions at 75-400 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth per Annex 7; pass if all values are below 52 + 15.13 log(F/75) dBµV/m.

text: In the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, the broadband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 63 dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1.).
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver) and is not exempted as a passive ESA.
test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions at 400-1,000 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth per Annex 7; pass if all values are below 63 dBµV/m.

text: In the frequency range 30-75 MHz, the narrowband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
quote: Limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth 30-75 MHz 75-400 MHz 400-1,000 MHz E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30)
condition: The lamp contains electronics generating narrowband emissions (e.g. microcontroller, oscillator, digital processor).
test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions at 30-75 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth per Annex 8; pass if all values are below 52 - 25.13 log(F/30) dBµV/m.

text: In the frequency range 75-400 MHz, the narrowband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
condition: The lamp contains electronics generating narrowband emissions (e.g. microcontroller, oscillator, digital processor).
test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions at 75-400 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth per Annex 8; pass if all values are below 42 + 15.13 log(F/75) dBµV/m.

text: In the frequency range 400-1,000 MHz, the narrowband radiated emissions of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) shall not exceed the reference limit E = 53 dBµV/m, measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1.).
condition: The lamp contains electronics generating narrowband emissions (e.g. microcontroller, oscillator, digital processor).
test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions at 400-1,000 MHz with 120 kHz bandwidth per Annex 8; pass if all values are below 53 dBµV/m.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω artificial network (AN) as defined in Figure 1 shall be used during testing.
quote: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics subject to ESA conducted/radiated testing.
test_case: Review the test setup/report to confirm a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN per Figure 1 was used on the LV supply lines.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, the AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane and the grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
quote: The AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane. The grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics subject to ESA testing.
test_case: Inspect the test setup to confirm the AN is mounted directly on and bonded to the ground plane.

text: For an ESA powered by LV, the measurement ports of the AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
quote: Measurement ports of AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics subject to ESA testing.
test_case: Inspect the test setup to confirm AN measurement ports are terminated with 50 Ω loads.

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 7, the test measuring broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
quote: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according CISPR 25.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/ECU) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Review the test report and confirm the radiated broadband emission test followed CISPR 25 unless Annex 7 states otherwise.

text: During the radiated broadband emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/ECU) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Check the test set-up record shows all lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) operating normally, at maximum load where possible.

text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the radiated broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
quote: the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/ECU) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Verify in the test report that the ALSE method of CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 was used (or an OATS per CISPR 16-1-4 as permitted alternative).

text: To ensure there is no extraneous noise or signal sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test, and the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1., except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/ECU) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Check the ambient scan recorded before or after the main test is at least 6 dB below the paragraph 6.5.2.1. limits.

text: The radiated broadband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or OATS.
quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE)
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/ECU) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Confirm emissions measured over 30 to 1,000 MHz remain below the paragraph 6.5. broadband limits.

text: If peak detectors are used for the radiated broadband emission measurements, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
quote: If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/ECU) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Review the report: where peak detection is used, verify a 20 dB correction was applied before comparing with the quasi-peak limits.

text: The radiated broadband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2.
quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Table 1 and Table 2.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/ECU) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Check instrument settings (RBW 120 kHz, scan/dwell times, step size) in the report match Table 1 or Table 2.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested, and the phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
quote: Unless otherwise specified the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/ECU) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Inspect test set-up photos to confirm harness orientation and antenna phase centre alignment with the harness centre.

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the radiated broadband emission test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/ECU) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Where any exceedance is recorded, verify the report documents an investigation distinguishing ESA emission from background.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken
condition: Lamp contains active electronics (LED driver/ECU) and is not exempted as a passive ESA
test_case: Check the report evaluates the maximum reading of both polarizations per frequency band against the limit.

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 8, the test of narrowband electromagnetic emissions of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
quote: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver/microprocessor) subject to narrowband emission testing
test_case: Review the test report and confirm the narrowband emission test was performed per CISPR 25.

text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load, during the narrowband emission tests.
quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver/microprocessor) subject to narrowband emission testing
test_case: Verify that the test plan and report show the lamp operated in normal mode with all functions (position, stop, reversing) energised at maximum load.

text: The narrowband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver/microprocessor) subject to narrowband emission testing
test_case: Check the test report confirms the ALSE set-up per CISPR 25 paragraph 6.4 (or an OATS complying with CISPR 16-1-4 as alternative).

text: Ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test, and the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver/microprocessor) subject to narrowband emission testing
test_case: Review the ambient scan in the test report and confirm the ambient is at least 6 dB below the paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits.

text: The narrowband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE)
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver/microprocessor) subject to narrowband emission testing
test_case: Measure radiated narrowband emissions from 30 to 1,000 MHz and confirm all readings are below the paragraph 6.6.2.1 limits.

text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver/microprocessor) subject to narrowband emission testing
test_case: Check the receiver settings in the test report specify an average detector.

text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2 (spectrum analyser: RBW 100/120 kHz at -3 dB, minimum scan time 100 ms/MHz; scanning receiver: BW 120 kHz at -6 dB, maximum step size 60 kHz, minimum dwell time 5 ms, for 30 to 1,000 MHz).
quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Tables 1 and 2.
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver/microprocessor) subject to narrowband emission testing
test_case: Verify the instrument settings in the test report match Table 1 or Table 2 parameters.

text: In the event that the narrowband limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver/microprocessor) subject to narrowband emission testing
test_case: For any exceedance, confirm the report documents an investigation distinguishing ESA narrowband emission from background or broadband radiation.

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken
condition: The lamp contains active electronics (e.g. LED driver/microprocessor) subject to narrowband emission testing
test_case: Check that the report evaluates the maximum of horizontal/vertical readings per band against the limit.

text: The ESA may comply with the requirements of any combination of the test methods (absorber chamber ISO 11452-2, TEM cell ISO 11452-3, bulk current injection ISO 11452-4, stripline ISO 11452-5, reverberation chamber ISO 11452-11) at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these result in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range
test_case: Review the immunity test plan/report and confirm the chosen methods together cover the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range.

text: For the immunity test of the ESA, the frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
quote: (Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1).
test_case: Check the test report states frequency range and general test conditions per ISO 11452-1.

text: The test conditions for the ESA immunity test shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Verify in the test report that test conditions comply with ISO 11452-1.

text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
test_case: Confirm during test that lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) are powered and operating normally.

text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
quote: It shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
test_case: Inspect test setup photos/report for arrangement per Annex 9 or the applicable ISO 11452 part.

text: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase, and no extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
quote: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase.
test_case: Check calibration records show no extraneous equipment present and none within 1 m of the reference point.

text: The test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
quote: the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.
test_case: Compare test and calibration setup records for identical signal generating equipment and layout.

text: If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit and the vehicle wiring harnesses are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
quote: If these are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
condition: The lamp ESA consists of more than one unit (e.g. separate LED driver/ECU) and vehicle harnesses are not available.
test_case: Measure the harness length between ECU and AN in the setup and compare with the ISO 11452 value.

text: Immunity measurements of the ESA shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Verify the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 frequency steps.

text: In the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
test_case: Check generator settings in report: AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth for 20-400 MHz.

text: In the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
quote: PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range
test_case: Check generator settings in report: PM2 Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs for 2,700-3,100 MHz.

text: In the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
quote: PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
test_case: Check generator settings in report: PM3 Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs for 380-2,700 and 3,100-6,000 MHz.

text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
quote: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
test_case: Verify step size and dwell time in the report comply with ISO 11452-1.

text: The test shall be performed at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz.
quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz.
test_case: Check the report shows test points at ISO 11452-1 intervals over 20-6,000 MHz (or accredited data with spot frequencies).

text: If the ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
quote: If an ESA fails the tests defined in this Annex, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions
test_case: For any failure, review field monitoring data to confirm failure occurred under controlled test conditions.

text: For the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
quote: The "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
condition: The absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2) is selected.
test_case: Verify the report states substitution method field calibration per ISO 11452-2.

text: For the absorber chamber test, the test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
quote: The test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
condition: The absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2) is selected.
test_case: Check antenna polarization recorded in the report is vertical.

text: For TEM cell testing, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
condition: TEM cell testing is selected.
test_case: Verify the TEM cell test report references and follows ISO 11452-3.

text: For bulk current injection testing, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with either the BCI substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or the BCI closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method
condition: Bulk current injection testing is selected.
test_case: Check report for ISO 11452-4 bench test with probe at 150 mm (substitution) or 900 mm (closed loop).

text: For stripline testing, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
quote: Test methodology The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
condition: Stripline testing is selected.
test_case: Verify the stripline test report references and follows ISO 11452-5.

text: For the reverberation chamber test, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11 and, unless otherwise specified, using a test setup with ground plane.
quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11. Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
condition: Reverberation chamber testing is selected.
test_case: Verify the report follows ISO 11452-11 with a ground plane setup.

text: The test method for the ESA shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs
condition: The lamp's LED modules/driver electronics are treated as an ESA requiring UN R10 approval (not exempted as passive).
test_case: Review the conducted transient test plan and report to confirm both immunity and emission transient tests on the power supply are covered.

text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines
condition: The lamp's LED modules/driver electronics are treated as an ESA requiring UN R10 approval (not exempted as passive).
test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the lamp supply and related lines and verify the functional performance status meets the required class.

text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines; ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs
condition: The lamp is an ESA requiring UN R10 approval and is not exclusively reserved for electric vehicles without a 12V/24V starter motor.
test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the lamp supply lines and verify the functional status classification is met, or document EV-only exclusivity.

text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected
condition: The lamp's LED modules/driver electronics are treated as an ESA requiring UN R10 approval (not exempted as passive).
test_case: Measure conducted transient emissions from the lamp per ISO 7637-2 on supply lines and verify they are within the regulation limits.

text: The external surface of the vehicle (including the rear lamp lens and housing) shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness
test_case: Inspect the installed rear lamp's outer surface for outward-directed pointed or sharp parts or injurious projections; pass if none are found.

text: The external surface of the vehicle (including the rear lamp lens and housing) shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
test_case: Inspect the installed rear lamp for outward-directed hooks, edges or features likely to catch; pass if none are found.

text: No protruding part of the external surface (including the rear lamp lens and housing) shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
quote: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
test_case: Measure the radii of curvature of the protruding parts of the installed rear lamp with radius gauges; pass if all are at least 2.5 mm.

text: The radius of curvature requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
quote: This requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted
test_case: Measure the protrusion of the rear lamp parts; for parts protruding between 1.5 mm and 5 mm, verify that their outward-facing angles are blunted.

text: For protruding parts of the external surface made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A having a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, the hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
quote: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
condition: Rear lamp has soft protruding parts (e.g. TPE/silicone seal) with hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A and radius below 2.5 mm
test_case: Measure the Shore A hardness of the soft protruding parts with the lamp installed on the vehicle; pass if hardness is at most 60 Shore A.

text: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
quote: Where it is impossible to carry out a hardness measurement by the Shore A procedure, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.
condition: Rear lamp relies on the soft-material exemption and Shore A measurement is impossible
test_case: Verify that an equivalent hardness measurement method was used and documented where the Shore A procedure is not feasible.

text: If the dimension of the projection of the rear lamp mounted on a surface other than convex cannot be determined by simple measurement, it shall be determined by the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over and is in constant contact with that component.
quote: it shall be determined by the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel
condition: The rear lamp is mounted on a surface other than convex and its projection cannot be determined by simple measurement.
test_case: Move a 100 mm diameter sphere over the installed lamp in constant contact and record the maximum variation of the sphere centre from the nominal panel line; use this as the projection dimension and check it against the applicable limit.

text: The dimension of the projection of the rear lamp mounted on a convex surface may be determined either directly or by reference to a drawing of an appropriate section of this component in its installed condition.
quote: The dimension of the projection of a component which is mounted on a convex surface may be determined either directly or by reference to a drawing
condition: The rear lamp is mounted on a convex surface of the vehicle.
test_case: Measure the installed lamp's projection directly or from an installed-condition section drawing, and check it against the applicable limit.

text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
test_case: Inspect the lamp mounting on the vehicle and check after vibration in normal use that the lamp keeps its prescribed position, orientation and characteristics.

text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
test_case: Inspect the fixing and adjustment means to confirm the lamp cannot be maladjusted without deliberate action.

text: For all light-signalling devices, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° in each direction.
quote: the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road
test_case: Measure the installed reference axis of each rear function relative to the road plane; pass if within ±3°.

text: For the rear signalling devices (other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps), the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° in each direction.
quote: and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices. In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
test_case: Measure the installed reference axis relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane; pass if parallel within ±3°.

text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
test_case: Compare the installation against the manufacturer's fitting instructions; pass if all instructions are followed.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
quote: the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface
test_case: Place the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface and measure the lamp height and orientation.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp
test_case: Measure the left and right lamp positions from the median longitudinal plane; pass if symmetrical based on the exterior lamp form.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane; this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
quote: Be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp
test_case: Compare the exterior geometry of the left and right lamps; pass if they are mirror-symmetrical.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
quote: Satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the left and right lamps of each function; pass if both meet the same colour requirements.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function.
quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
test_case: Compare the photometric test results of the left and right lamps; pass if substantially identical.

text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle, and all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.
quote: only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle
condition: The lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo.
test_case: Inspect the rear lamps for logos; pass if there is at most one logo per side or one central logo and only vehicle or body manufacturer logos are used.

text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the requirements for lamps constituting a pair shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
quote: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the above requirements shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
condition: The target vehicle has an asymmetrical external shape.
test_case: Assess the pair symmetry on the asymmetrical vehicle; pass if the pair requirements are met as far as possible.

text: Lamps grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another shall fulfil all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any.
quote: provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled
test_case: Verify each function in the combination lamp separately for colour, position, orientation, visibility and wiring; pass if all requirements are met.

text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
test_case: Measure each function (position, stop, reversing) with the other functions switched OFF; pass if its photometric and colour limits are met.

text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the rear position lamps are switched ON.
quote: the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON
condition: The rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with another function (e.g. the stop lamp).
test_case: Switch ON the rear position lamp together with the reciprocally incorporated function and measure chromaticity; pass if within the colour limits.

text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are not permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.
quote: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are not permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.
condition: The lamp integrates a direction-indicator function.
test_case: Inspect the design to confirm the stop lamp and any direction indicator do not share a light source or light-emitting surface.

text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour.
quote: shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour
condition: The lamp groups the stop lamp with a direction-indicator lamp.
test_case: Project the apparent surfaces and draw horizontal and vertical lines; pass if no line crosses more than two colour borderlines.

text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, shall not overlap.
quote: Their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, do not overlap.
condition: The lamp groups the stop lamp with a direction-indicator lamp.
test_case: Project the apparent surfaces along the reference axis; pass if the stop and direction-indicator surfaces do not overlap.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis; these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
quote: shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis
condition: A lamp function has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts.
test_case: Measure the projected apparent surface parts; pass if they fill at least 60 % of the circumscribing quadrilateral or the gap between facing edges is at most 75 mm.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing these projections, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
quote: composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that
condition: A function is provided by two lamps marked "D" or by two independent retro-reflectors (e.g. split between body and tailgate).
test_case: Measure the projected apparent surfaces of the two units; pass if they fill at least 60 % of the circumscribing quadrilateral or the edge gap is at most 75 mm.

text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
quote: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
condition: A function is realised as an interdependent lamp system.
test_case: Apply the 60 % or 75 mm criteria of paragraph 5.7.2.1. to the interdependent lamp system; pass if one is met.

text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and shall be not less than 0.8 m long; the illumination of such a surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
quote: extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, and are not less than 0.8 m long
condition: A function is realised as a lamp in the shape of a band or strip forming a single lamp.
test_case: Measure the strip length, symmetry, distance to the vehicle outer edge and light source positions; pass if they meet the stated limits.

text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface
test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface above the ground; check them against the height limits.

text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
quote: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.
condition: Reduced geometric visibility angles are claimed because of the lamp mounting height.
test_case: Measure the lamp height from the H plane when applying reduced vertical visibility angles.

text: The position of the rear lamps, as regards width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps.
quote: The position, as regards width, will be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest
test_case: Measure lateral position from the outer and inner edges of the apparent surface in the reference axis direction and check that the values used for compliance follow this method.

text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
quote: the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON
test_case: Operate each function and observe/measure intensity, colour and apparent surface over time; no intentional variation is permitted.

text: Any variation of the photometric characteristics of the lamp in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
quote: provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned
condition: The lamp varies its photometric characteristics (e.g. variable intensity, shared LEDs for position/stop).
test_case: Measure photometry in each varying operating state and verify compliance with the lamp's device approval provisions.

text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect the installed lamp from the front of the vehicle; no red light from the rear lamp shall be visible.

text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
quote: there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front
test_case: Observe from Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle per Annex 4; the red apparent surfaces shall not be directly visible.

text: In case of doubt, the requirement on visibility of red light to the front shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
quote: is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable
test_case: Measure luminous intensity of red light emitted towards the front, including body influence; pass if ≤ 0.25 cd per lamp.

text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps, the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
quote: the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously
test_case: Operate the vehicle lighting switch and verify the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF simultaneously with the other listed lamps (except in the 5.11.1 conditions).

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
condition: The rear lamp functions are realised as an interdependent lamp system.
test_case: Switch the function ON and OFF and verify all light sources of the interdependent system change state simultaneously.

text: The concealment of the rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors shall be prohibited.
quote: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps
test_case: Inspect the installation; the rear lamp shall not be fitted with any concealment device.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
quote: Reversing lamp: White
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the reversing lamp and verify it is within the white boundaries.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
quote: Stop lamp: Red
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the stop lamp and verify it is within the red boundaries.

text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
quote: Rear position lamp: Red
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the rear position lamp and verify it is within the red boundaries.

text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red
test_case: Measure the colour of the retro-reflected light and verify it is red.

text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
test_case: Count installed lamps per function and compare with the individual specifications in paragraph 6.

text: The lamp may be installed on movable components only provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
condition: The lamp (or part of it) is installed on a movable component such as a tailgate or boot lid.
test_case: Verify, for a lamp on a movable component, that 5.18, 5.19 and 5.20 are met.

text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements
condition: Rear position lamp or retro-reflector installed on a movable component.
test_case: Place the movable component in each fixed position and verify position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the lamps.

text: Where the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector functions are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
quote: only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components
condition: Function obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" with one on a movable component.
test_case: At all fixed positions of the movable component, verify at least one of the "D" lamps meets position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements.

text: Where additional lamps for the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector functions are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
quote: provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component
condition: Additional lamps are switched ON when the movable component is open.
test_case: With the movable component in each fixed open position, verify the additional lamps meet position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements.

text: Where the rear position lamp function is obtained by an interdependent lamp system completely mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied, and any additional lamps switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
