quote: Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system fully mounted on a movable component.
test_case: Verify 5.18.1 compliance at all fixed positions and compliance of any additional lamps.

text: Where the rear position lamp function is obtained by an interdependent lamp system partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
quote: the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components.
test_case: At all fixed positions of the movable component, verify the specified interdependent lamp(s) meet position, outward visibility, colour and photometry, and inward photometric values.

text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
quote: the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users
condition: The lamp is installed on a movable component.
test_case: Assess the lamp with the movable component open; no undue discomfort (e.g. glare) to road users.

text: When the lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
quote: the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation
condition: The lamp is installed on a movable component.
test_case: Cycle the movable component and verify the lamp returns to the manufacturer-specified position.

text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
quote: shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position
test_case: Place each movable component in each fixed position and measure the hidden portion of the apparent surface; pass if ≤ 50 %.

text: If the 50 per cent requirement is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON
condition: The apparent surface is hidden more than 50 % by a movable component in a fixed open position.
test_case: With the movable component in such position, verify additional compliant lamps switch ON.

text: If more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface of the lamp in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road; this does not apply to retro-reflectors.
quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned
condition: Lamp (other than the retro-reflector) is mounted on a movable component such as the tailgate or boot lid and more than 50 % of its apparent surface can be hidden
test_case: Check the vehicle documentation/notice for the required user warning when the movable component can hide more than 50 % of the lamp apparent surface.

text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
quote: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the rear position, stop and reversing lamps operate without any action beyond installing a light source and/or fuse.

text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s), shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
quote: shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 37
test_case: Replace the light source on the installed lamp using only vehicle-supplied tools and confirm correct replacement without expert assistance.

text: For lamps approved with replaceable light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, the vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 37
test_case: Check that the vehicle documentation contains a detailed light source replacement procedure.

text: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
quote: In the case where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37
condition: Light source module includes a holder for an R37 replaceable light source
test_case: Verify the R37 light source in the module can be replaced per paragraph 5.23 without special tools.

text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
quote: provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate
condition: The lamp provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function
test_case: Simulate failure of the rear position lamp and verify the replacement function has similar colour, intensity and position while the replacement device keeps its original function.

text: During temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function, a tell-tale on the dashboard shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
condition: The lamp provides a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function
test_case: Simulate failure and verify the dashboard tell-tale indicates temporary replacement and need for repair.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, the intensity of all such lamps, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
quote: The intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Vary the intensity control conditions and measure that R2 and S2 intensities change together in the same manner and similar proportion.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
quote: In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Measure stop/position intensity ratio across the full variation range and transitions and confirm the prescribed ratio is maintained.

text: For R2 rear position lamps and S2 stop lamps with variable luminous intensity, increase and decrease of the luminous intensity in relation to environmental conditions shall remain in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
quote: Increase and decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed in relation to the following conditions
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Verify intensity variation under the listed environmental conditions stays within R148 limits.

text: For R2 rear position lamps and S2 stop lamps with variable luminous intensity, a decrease of the luminous intensity related to traffic conditions, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed only as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m, and an already activated decrease may remain active only as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h.
quote: a decrease of the luminous intensity, in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, is allowed as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable intensity responding to traffic conditions
test_case: Check control logic: decrease activates only at ≤20 km/h or ≤20 m following distance and is cancelled above 50 km/h.

text: For lamps with variable luminous intensity, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
quote: No sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 and/or stop lamp is category S2 with variable luminous intensity control
test_case: Record luminous intensity during transitions and confirm no abrupt step changes.

text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
quote: shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
condition: Lamp was approved with a special power supply/control gear, secondary operating mode or applicant-requested voltage and does not include an electronic light source control gear, variable intensity control or only R128 light sources
test_case: Measure terminal voltage at constant vehicle voltage operating condition and confirm it does not exceed the approved voltage.

text: For vehicles of M and N categories, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
quote: the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V
condition: Lamp does not include an electronic light source control gear, a variable intensity control as part of the device, or only R128-approved light sources
test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp terminals at constant vehicle operating voltage and confirm it is ≤ 13.5 V +3 % for a 12 V system.

text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except obstacles already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface
test_case: Check on the installed vehicle that no vehicle part obstructs the apparent surface within the required geometric visibility angles.

text: If measurements of geometric visibility are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
test_case: Verify near-field visibility measurements use parallel-shifted observation directions.

text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
quote: proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
condition: Part of the lamp apparent surface is hidden by other vehicle parts when installed
test_case: Photometrically measure the lamp with the obstruction simulated and confirm the prescribed values are still met.

text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: Any function is realised as an interdependent lamp system (e.g. split between body and tailgate)
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify geometric visibility angles are met.

text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6
test_case: Check the rear position, stop, reversing lamp and retro-reflector carry valid R148/R150 approval marks.

text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
condition: The lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo
test_case: Verify the logo-bearing lamp holds an R148 approval covering the logo.

text: Lamps installed on a vehicle approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only; this does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
quote: shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only.
condition: Lamp uses replaceable light sources approved under R37 or R128
test_case: Inspect fitted light sources and confirm they carry approvals matching the lamp's approved categories.

text: Lamps equipped with LED substitute light source(s) shall be used only where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive, and the presence of the marking on the lamps related to the use of LED substitute light source(s) shall be checked.
quote: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s), is allowed exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive.
condition: Lamp uses LED substitute light source(s)
test_case: Check the vehicle documentation statement and the LED substitute marking on the lamp.

text: The reversing lamp shall be present (mandatory) on motor vehicles.
quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation; pass if at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

text: On motor vehicles of category M1, one reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second device is optional.
quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1
test_case: Count reversing lamps installed on the M1 vehicle; pass if one or two devices are fitted.

text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23
test_case: Check the lamp carries a valid R23 or R148 approval mark for the reversing function; pass if present.

text: In height, the reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
test_case: Measure apparent surface heights of the installed reversing lamp; pass if within 250 mm to 1,200 mm above ground.

text: In length, the reversing lamp shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device.
quote: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device
condition: Only one reversing lamp is installed on the vehicle.
test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of the apparent surface over 15° up, 5° down and 45° left/right; pass if visible throughout.

text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two devices.
quote: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two
condition: Two reversing lamps are installed on the vehicle.
test_case: Verify unobstructed visibility of each lamp's apparent surface over 15° up, 5° down, 45° outwards and 30° inwards; pass if visible throughout.

text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards
test_case: Inspect the installed lamp reference axis; pass if directed rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls
test_case: Functional vehicle test with reverse gear and ignition states; pass if lamp lights only with reverse engaged and propulsion operable.

text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.
test_case: Disengage reverse gear or switch off propulsion while lamp is lit; pass if lamp switches OFF and cannot be switched ON.

text: For the reversing lamp, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
quote: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
condition: The component regulation (R23/R148) requires a failure tell-tale for this reversing lamp.
test_case: Check component approval requirements; if required, simulate lamp failure and confirm tell-tale activates.

text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories are mandatory on all categories of vehicles (including M1).
quote: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and approval marking to confirm stop lamps of category S1 or S2 are fitted.

text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be installed on all categories of vehicles.
quote: Number Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
test_case: Count the S1/S2 stop lamp devices fitted on the vehicle (left and right rear lamps); pass if exactly two are present.

text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00
test_case: Check the approval mark on the rear lamp and approval certificate for an S1/S2 stop lamp approval under R7 (02 or later) or R148 (00 or later).

text: For M1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the mounting height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices: Above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible
test_case: Measure the height of the stop lamp apparent surface above ground per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified by bodywork).

text: In length, S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: For S1 or S2 categories devices: at the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation; pass if the stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; however, for stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
quote: Horizontal angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle.
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the stop lamp apparent surface is unobstructed over 45° left and right (20° inward under H plane if mounted below 750 mm).

text: For S1 or S2 categories stop lamp devices, the vertical angle of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angle: For S1 or S2 categories devices: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the stop lamp apparent surface is visible 15° above and below horizontal (5° downward if mounted below 750 mm).

text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
quote: Orientation Towards the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if the stop lamp reference axis points towards the rear of the vehicle.

text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
quote: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
test_case: Apply the brake signal on the vehicle and observe; pass if all stop lamps switch ON simultaneously.

text: For the stop lamps, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
quote: Tell-tale optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
condition: Whether the component regulation (UN R148) requires a failure tell-tale for this stop lamp (e.g. LED failure monitoring).
test_case: Check component approval; if a failure tell-tale is required, simulate stop lamp failure and verify the tell-tale activates.

text: The rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
quote: Presence Devices of R or R1 or R2 categories: Mandatory
test_case: Inspect vehicle; pass if rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
quote: Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series
test_case: Check vehicle has two rear position lamps bearing an approval mark per R7 (02+) or R148 (00+).

text: In width, that point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm
test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the rear position lamp apparent surface to the vehicle extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

text: In height, the rear position lamps shall be above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible
test_case: Measure the height of the rear position lamp apparent surface per paragraph 5.8.1; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

text: In length, the rear position lamps shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: The rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if rear position lamps are at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the rear position lamp apparent surface is visible from 45° inwards to 80° outwards (20° inward under H plane if below 750 mm).

text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, (a) Where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the rear position lamp apparent surface is visible 15° above and below horizontal (5° downward if below 750 mm).

text: For M1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be horizontal 45° outwards to 45° inwards (inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane where mounted below 750 mm) and vertical 15° above and below the horizontal (downward angle may be reduced to 5° where mounted below 750 mm).
quote: as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed
condition: Manufacturer opts for the alternative visibility and a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle.
test_case: If the alternative is used, confirm rear side-marker lamp presence and verify visibility 45° out to 45° in and 15° up/down.

text: When the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is used, to be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
condition: Manufacturer opts for the alternative visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2.
test_case: Measure the unobstructed apparent surface at the boundary angles excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

text: The rear position lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards.
test_case: Inspect installation; pass if rear position lamp reference axis points rearwards.

text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11.
test_case: Check the vehicle wiring and switching of the rear position lamps against paragraph 5.11 requirements.

text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps is mandatory and it shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
test_case: Switch on the rear position lamps on the vehicle and verify a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates, shared with the front position lamp tell-tale.

text: For the rear position lamps, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
quote: However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
condition: Whether the component Regulation (R148/R7) requires failure indication for this lamp, e.g. due to electronic control or LED failure provisions.
test_case: Check the component Regulation requirements and simulate a rear position lamp failure to verify the failure tell-tale activates where required.

text: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
quote: In all cases, the distance between the rear fog-lamp and each stop-lamp shall be greater than 100 mm.
test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance between the rear fog lamp and each stop lamp of the rear lamp and verify it exceeds 100 mm.

text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, is mandatory on motor vehicles.
quote: Presence Mandatory on motor vehicles.
test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle and verify that non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are fitted.

text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
quote: Two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3
test_case: Verify two rear retro-reflectors are fitted and that each bears a Class IA or IB approval mark under R3 (02+) or R150 (00+).

text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
quote: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below), are permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness
condition: Whether additional retro-reflecting devices or materials are fitted.
test_case: Inspect any additional retro-reflecting devices and verify they do not obstruct or impair the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
quote: that point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge
test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge and verify it is ≤ 400 mm.

text: In height, the rear retro-reflector shall be above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively).
quote: Above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s)
test_case: Measure the mounting height of the retro-reflector above ground per paragraph 5.8 and verify it is between 250 mm and 900 mm (1,200 mm if grouped, 1,500 mm if bodywork prevents).

text: In length, the rear retro-reflector shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle and verify the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
quote: Geometric visibility Horizontal angle: 30° inwards and outwards.
test_case: Verify on the installed lamp that the retro-reflector is visible over 30° inwards and outwards horizontally.

text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
quote: Vertical angle: 10° above and below horizontal. However, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm
test_case: Verify on the installed lamp that the retro-reflector is visible 10° above and 10° below horizontal (5° downward if mounted below 750 mm).

text: The orientation of the rear retro-reflector shall be rearwards.
quote: Orientation Rearwards.
test_case: Inspect the installed retro-reflector and verify its reference axis is directed rearwards.

text: Triangular rear retro-reflectors are prohibited on motor vehicles; the rear retro-reflector of the lamp shall not be triangular.
quote: Presence Mandatory on trailers. Prohibited on motor vehicles.
test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector shape and verify it is not triangular.

text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON; however, the rear position lamps may be switched OFF when the daytime running lamps are switched ON, and may remain switched OFF as long as the ambient light conditions outside the vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
quote: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON.
test_case: On the vehicle, switch on the daytime running lamps under ambient light at or below 7,000 lux (Annex 13 method) and check that the rear position lamps are ON.

text: Conspicuity markings are prohibited on vehicles of category M1; the rear lamp intended for M1 vehicles shall not incorporate or be fitted with conspicuity markings.
quote: Prohibited: on vehicles of categories M1 and O1.
test_case: Inspect the lamp and its installation on the M1 vehicle; pass if no conspicuity marking (retro-reflective marking material) is fitted.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
condition: The vehicle's emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp (rather than by direction-indicator lamps)
test_case: Trigger emergency braking on the vehicle and verify visually that all fitted stop lamps operate simultaneously.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the number of lamps shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.2.
quote: Number As specified in paragraph 6.5.2. or 6.7.2.
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp
test_case: Count the stop lamps used for the emergency stop signal on the vehicle and check against paragraph 6.7.2.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the arrangement shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.3.
quote: Arrangement As specified in paragraph 6.5.3. or 6.7.3.
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp
test_case: Inspect the arrangement of the stop lamps on the vehicle and check against paragraph 6.7.3.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the position shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.4.
quote: Position As specified in paragraph 6.5.4. or 6.7.4.
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp
test_case: Measure width, height and length position of the stop lamps on the vehicle against paragraph 6.7.4.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the geometric visibility shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.5.
quote: Geometric visibility As specified in paragraph 6.5.5. or 6.7.5.
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp
test_case: Verify the angles of geometric visibility of the stop lamps on the vehicle against paragraph 6.7.5.

text: Where the emergency stop signal is provided by the stop lamps, the orientation shall be as specified in paragraph 6.7.6.
quote: Orientation As specified in paragraph 6.5.6. or 6.7.6.
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp
test_case: Check the orientation of the stop lamps on the vehicle against paragraph 6.7.6.

text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
quote: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp
test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and measure the flash frequency and phase of all lamps; pass if in phase and within 3.0-5.0 Hz.

text: If any of the lamps of the emergency stop signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources, the frequency shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
quote: if any of the lamps of the emergency stop signal to the rear of the vehicle use filament light sources the frequency shall be 4.0 +0.0/-1.0 Hz.
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps and any rear lamp of the signal uses filament light sources
test_case: Measure flash frequency of the emergency stop signal; pass if within 3.0-4.0 Hz.

text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp
test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with other lamps in various states and verify it operates independently.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp
test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the emergency stop signal activates and deactivates without manual control.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp
test_case: Perform emergency braking above and below 50 km/h; pass if the signal activates only above 50 km/h with the emergency braking logic signal present.

text: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
quote: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided
condition: The emergency stop signal is produced by the stop lamps of this rear lamp
test_case: Remove the emergency braking logic signal and separately activate the hazard warning signal; pass if the emergency stop signal switches OFF in both cases.

text: If the lamps of the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp or reversing lamp) are used for the answer-back signal, the answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
quote: The answer-back signal shall only operate under the park condition of a vehicle.
condition: The vehicle uses a function of this rear lamp (e.g. rear position or reversing lamp) to provide an answer-back signal.
test_case: Activate the answer-back signal in park and in non-park vehicle states; pass if it operates only in the park condition.

text: If the answer-back signal provided by the lamps of the rear combination lamp flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
quote: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
condition: A function of this rear lamp is used for a flashing answer-back signal.
test_case: Measure the flash frequency of the answer-back signal; pass if it does not exceed 2.0 Hz.

text: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices where the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line; stop lamps are not permitted to be used for the answer-back signal.
quote: the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line. However, front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.
condition: A function of this rear lamp is used to provide an answer-back signal.
test_case: Verify the lamp used is approved and not the stop lamp, and measure intensity in answer-back mode; pass if it does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line.

text: The answer-back signal provided by the lamps of the rear combination lamp may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
quote: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user
condition: A function of this rear lamp is used to provide an answer-back signal.
test_case: Check activation triggers of the answer-back signal; pass if it is activated only by door locking/unlocking and/or user proximity detection.

text: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal provided by the lamps of the rear combination lamp shall not exceed 3 seconds, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
quote: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds.
condition: A function of this rear lamp is used to provide an answer-back signal.
test_case: Time the answer-back signal from beginning to end; pass if the duration does not exceed 3 s.

text: For verifying the visibility of a red lamp to the front (see paragraph 5.10.4.), the zone 1 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground, and in width by a vertical plane forming to the front an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, passing through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane.
quote: In height, by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m respectively above the ground
test_case: On the vehicle, observe from zone 1 (1 m to 2.2 m height, 15° outwards forward plane) and verify that no direct light from the red rear position and stop lamps is visible.

text: For verifying the visibility of a white lamp to the rear (see paragraph 5.10.4.), the zone 2 explored by the eye of the observer shall be bounded in height by two horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground, and in width by a vertical plane forming to the rear an angle of 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, passing through the point or points of contact of vertical planes parallel to the vehicle's median longitudinal plane delimiting the vehicle's overall width; if there are several points of contact, the rearmost shall correspond to the rearward plane.
quote: if there are several points of contact, the foremost shall correspond to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
test_case: On the vehicle, observe from zone 2 (1 m to 2.2 m height, 15° outwards rearward plane) and verify white light to the rear is only from permitted lamps such as the reversing lamp.

text: The values measured for the distances of the position of the lamps in width, in height and in length, checked in accordance with paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4., shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
quote: The values measured for the distances shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Measure the lamp position in width, height and length on the vehicle and confirm that each value meets the individual specification for the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the retro-reflector.

text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility, checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7., shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
quote: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits
test_case: Measure the geometric visibility angles of each function on the vehicle and confirm they meet the individual specifications within the ±3° allowance.

text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10.
quote: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10.
test_case: Inspect the vehicle according to paragraph 5.10 and confirm that no red light from the lamp is visible towards the front and that no prohibited white light is visible towards the rear.

text: When every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle is switched on, the lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
quote: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation
test_case: Switch on each function (position, stop, reversing) and confirm that the lamp and the related tell-tale operate as required by paragraphs 5.11 to 5.14 and the individual specifications.

text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps, checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings, shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
quote: These shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
test_case: Visually inspect the lamps and their approval markings and confirm that presence, number, colour, arrangement and category comply with paragraphs 5.15 and 5.16 and the individual specifications.

text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamps), each of these lamps shall satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
quote: approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation
test_case: Verify that each function in the combination lamp has a passing test report against R148 (or the relevant Regulation).

text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of the unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
quote: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
test_case: Review the BOM and function list to confirm that no non-compliant or non-approved lamp function is integrated in the housing.

text: All the devices of an interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
quote: All the devices of an interdependent lamp system must be submitted for type approval by the same applicant.
condition: Any function is part of an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Check the approval application to confirm that all interdependent lamps are submitted by the same applicant.

text: The rear position lamp shall be identified by the symbol R1 (steady) or R2 (variable) as listed in Table 1.
quote: Rear position lamp (steady) R1 5.2. ... Rear position lamp (variable) R2 5.2.
test_case: Inspect the marking for the R1 or R2 symbol, consistent with the steady or variable intensity design.

text: The stop lamp shall be identified by the symbol S1 (steady) or S2 (variable) as listed in Table 1.
quote: Stop lamp (steady) S1 5.5. Stop lamp (variable) S2 5.5.
test_case: Inspect the marking for the S1 or S2 symbol, consistent with the steady or variable intensity design.

text: The reversing lamp shall be identified by the symbol AR (the letters A and R may be mingled) as listed in Table 1.
quote: Reversing lamp (note: the letters A and R may be mingled) AR 5.8.
test_case: Inspect the marking for the AR symbol.

text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings
test_case: Inspect the drawing and sample for a marking space large enough for all required markings.

text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible,
test_case: Visually check legibility, then rub the markings (e.g. with a solvent-soaked cloth) and confirm that they remain legible.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval mark and confirm that it is ≥ 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle with E and the country number.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
quote: The four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
test_case: Inspect the marking for a 4-6 digit sequential number matching the approval number.

text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
test_case: Visually confirm that the sequential number is adjacent to the E-circle.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
quote: The symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
test_case: Inspect the marking for symbols matching each approved function (e.g. R1/R2, S1/S2, AR).

text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force
test_case: Inspect the marking for "148R" followed by the series digits (e.g. 148R01).

text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall include a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
quote: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
condition: The lamp is handed (left/right specific)
test_case: For handed lamps, inspect the marking for a horizontal arrow indicating the mounting position.

text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of rear position lamps.
quote: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of: ... (b) Front or rear position lamps
condition: The lamp is handed (left/right specific)
test_case: Confirm that the arrow on the handed rear position lamp points outboard when the lamp is installed.

text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
quote: (c) Reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
condition: The reversing lamp has reduced light distribution as one of two reversing lamps
test_case: Confirm that the arrow on the reversing lamp with reduced light distribution points outboard.

text: If applicable, the additional letter "D" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
quote: (a) The additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps;
condition: A function is approved as part of an assembly of two independent lamps
test_case: Inspect for the letter D to the right of the function symbol.

text: If applicable, the additional letter "Y" shall be placed to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4. on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
quote: (b) The additional letter "Y", on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
condition: A function is part of an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Inspect for the letter Y to the right of the function symbol.

text: On lamps with reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the approval marking shall include a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
quote: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
condition: The lamp is approved with reduced light distribution
test_case: Inspect the marking for a downward vertical arrow from a horizontal segment.

text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
quote: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the presence of the complete approval marking.

text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: Lamps, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
quote: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating: (a) The category or categories of light source(s) prescribed;
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light sources
test_case: For a lamp with replaceable light sources, inspect for the light source category marking.

text: In the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), the lamp shall also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
quote: in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s);
condition: The lamp is approved for LED substitute light sources
test_case: Inspect for the LED substitute light source category marking.

text: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear, a variable luminous intensity control, a secondary operating mode and/or non-replaceable light sources.
quote: Lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage, in the case of lamps with:
condition: The lamp has non-replaceable light sources, electronic control gear, variable intensity control or a secondary operating mode
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking (e.g. 12V).

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant, the specific identification code of the module (starting letters "MD" followed by the approval mark without the circle) and the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
quote: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, bear the following markings. (a) On the light source module(s):
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used
test_case: Inspect each module for the trade name, the MD identification code and the rated voltage.

text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module and the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
quote: (b) On the lamp: (i) The specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii); (ii) The rated voltage(s)
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used
test_case: Inspect the lamp for the module identification code and the rated voltage.

text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
quote: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked
condition: An external control gear or variable intensity control is part of the lamp
test_case: Inspect the external control gear for its identification number and the manufacturer name.

text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
quote: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated
test_case: Verify that the marking location is on a part that is not separable from the light-emitting lens.

text: The approval marking, as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
quote: the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted
test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle (movable parts opened if needed), confirm that the marking is visible.

text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
quote: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both
condition: The outer lens is designed to be separable from the housing
test_case: For a detachable lens, inspect both the lens and the body for the approval marking.

text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bears different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
quote: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only
condition: The outer lens is shared by several separately approved devices
test_case: Inspect each device body and confirm that it carries only its own function markings.

text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
quote: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
test_case: Inspect the lamp and confirm that all of these markings are affixed to it.

text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the light source module component.
quote: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
condition: Replaceable light source modules are used
test_case: Inspect the module component for the 3.3.3.5(a) markings.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the marking shall be visible after their installation.
quote: This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that: It is visible after their installation;
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated lamps
test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the vehicle (or in its mounting position) and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated lamps
test_case: Review the design and disassembly: confirm every light-transmitting part (e.g. outer lens) carries or cannot be removed without the approval mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks
condition: A single approval mark is used for the grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated lamps
test_case: Measure the characters of the single approval mark and compare with the minimum sizes of the pertinent Regulations.

text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
quote: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
test_case: Verify via the type approval test report that all paragraph 4 and 5 requirements are passed for each lamp function.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply, the requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed being applied where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied
test_case: Check the R48 sections 5 and 6 provisions verifiable at lamp level (e.g. geometric visibility, colours) for the rear position, stop and reversing lamps on M1.

text: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected
test_case: Perform vibration/durability testing and re-measure photometry and colour; confirm operation and characteristics remain within limits.

text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source) or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
quote: in the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources
condition: The rear position lamp and stop lamp are reciprocally incorporated
test_case: Review the circuit design to confirm multiple light sources are used or the lamp is declared for vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

text: If a manufacturer logo is incorporated in the rear position lamp, only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.
quote: Irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer is allowed.
condition: A manufacturer logo is incorporated in the apparent surface of the rear position lamp
test_case: Inspect the logo and the applicant statement to confirm it is the vehicle or body manufacturer brand logo only.

text: If a manufacturer logo is incorporated, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
quote: the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2
condition: A manufacturer logo is incorporated in the apparent surface of the rear position lamp
test_case: Measure the projected logo light-emitting surface along the reference axis and confirm it is ≤ 100 cm2.

text: Stop lamps and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
quote: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
test_case: Inspect the stop and reversing lamp apparent surfaces and confirm no logo is incorporated.

text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
quote: a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source
test_case: Review the LED wiring schematic and identify light-source groups considered as one light source for failure assessment.

text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, either the light intensity shall comply with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded, or a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in UN Regulation No. 48, shall be produced.
quote: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply
test_case: Simulate failure of each light source and measure intensities against Annex 3 minima, or verify a failure tell-tale signal is produced.

text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 or a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1 or S1 respectively, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
quote: Requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
condition: The rear position lamp is category R2 and/or the stop lamp is category S2 (variable intensity)
test_case: Simulate variable intensity control failure and confirm intensities fall automatically within R1/S1 steady limits.

text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
quote: The lamp shall only be equipped with: - replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128
test_case: Review the BOM to confirm all light sources are R37/R99/R128 approved, light source modules or non-replaceable light sources.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
quote: The design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Attempt to fit the light source in alternative orientations; confirm only the correct position is possible.

text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed (and of any LED substitute light source category also prescribed) applying.
quote: The light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061.
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Gauge the holder against the IEC 60061 data sheet for the prescribed light source category.

text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
quote: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
test_case: Perform EMC emission tests (e.g. per UN R10) and confirm no disturbance causing malfunction of other vehicle systems.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
quote: it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s)
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Attempt incorrect fitment and tool-less removal; confirm both are impossible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
quote: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Inspect the module design to confirm it cannot be opened or altered without destruction.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module shall not be interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
quote: regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with: - any replaceable UN approved light source
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Attempt to interchange modules and UN approved light sources within the housing; confirm not possible.

text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of the device shall be met.
quote: when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code
condition: The lamp uses replaceable light source modules
test_case: Replace the module with another of the same identification code and re-measure photometry against the limits.

text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraph 4.8., the particulars of the methods of measurement being given in Annex 3.
quote: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the following conditions.
test_case: Review the test report to confirm photometric and colorimetric measurements followed paragraph 4.8 and Annex 3 methods.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
quote: In the case of replaceable UN approved light sources, all measurements shall be made using standard light sources as specified in R.E.5.
condition: The lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Confirm the test report records use of R.E.5 standard light sources for measurements.

text: In the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value when test voltage is applied.
quote: the standard light source(s) shall have a luminous flux value that does not deviate more than 5 per cent from its reference/objective luminous flux value
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources controlled by electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Measure the luminous flux of the standard light sources at test voltage and confirm deviation from reference flux is ≤5 %.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
quote: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
condition: Lamp uses LED light source modules or non-replaceable LED light sources
