test_case: Verify in the test report that photometric and colorimetric measurements were made with the LED modules installed in the lamp.

text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be made separately, in accordance with each applicable condition(s) set forth in paragraph 4.8.
condition: A lamp function uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8
test_case: Check that each light-source group was measured separately under its applicable condition.

text: In case of a lamp (function) using light sources which are subject to more than one of the conditions prescribed in paragraph 4.8., all separate measurement results shall be added together.
quote: All separate measurement results shall be added together.
condition: A lamp function uses light sources subject to more than one condition of paragraph 4.8
test_case: Verify the reported intensities are the sum of the separate measurements.

text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
quote: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
test_case: Inspect the goniophotometer set-up for masking that prevents stray reflections during measurement.

text: In the case where the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one or in a field of different positions the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be repeated for each position or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer
condition: Lamp may be installed in more than one position or in a field of positions
test_case: Confirm photometric measurements were repeated at each declared position or at extreme positions of the reference axis field.

text: In the case where the lamp, at the discretion of the applicant, also has to be approved with LED substitute light source(s), all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed.
quote: all measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be repeated using the LED substitute light source(s) prescribed
condition: Lamp is also to be approved with LED substitute light sources
test_case: Repeat photometric and colorimetric tests with the LED substitute light sources and verify compliance.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
quote: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
test_case: Verify the light sources are continuously lit during intensity measurement.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable.
quote: The distance of measurement shall be such that the law of the inverse of the square of the distance is applicable
test_case: Check the measurement distance is sufficient for the inverse-square law to apply.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the measuring equipment shall be such that the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree.
quote: the angular aperture of the receiver viewed from the reference centre of the light is comprised between 10' and 1 degree
test_case: Verify the receiver angular aperture from the reference centre is between 10' and 1°.

text: In case the results of measurements should be challenged, the intensity requirement for a particular direction of observation shall be deemed to be satisfied if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation.
quote: if that requirement is met in a direction deviating by not more than one-quarter of a degree from the direction of observation
test_case: Evaluate disputed points within ±0.25° of the nominal direction and confirm compliance.

text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
quote: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
test_case: Determine and document the apparent surface limits of each function in the reference axis direction.

text: In the case of a lamp which is intended to be mounted inside the vehicle, a sample plate or sample plates (in case of different possibilities) as supplied shall be positioned in front of the lamp to be tested, in the geometrical position(s) as described in the application drawing(s).
quote: a sample plate or sample plates (in case of different possibilities) as supplied (see paragraph 3.1.2.8.) shall be positioned in front of the lamp to be tested
condition: Lamp is intended to be mounted inside the vehicle
test_case: Verify the supplied sample plate is positioned in front of the lamp during testing per the drawing.

text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
quote: the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems)
test_case: Measure the supply voltage at the lamp terminals during testing and confirm 13.5 V (12 V system) or as applicable.

text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: Lamp is controlled by an electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Operate the lamp per the applicant's declared conditions and verify the test report records them.

text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
quote: in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant
condition: Lamp uses LED modules/non-replaceable light sources without electronic control gear or variable intensity control
test_case: Operate the lamp per applicant specification and verify the test report records it.

text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of replaceable UN approved light source(s) the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction on the measured luminous intensities.
quote: the light sources shall be operated at the reference/objective luminous flux or alternatively at a different luminous flux with a proportional correction
condition: Lamp uses replaceable UN approved light sources without electronic control gear
test_case: Verify the light sources are operated at reference flux or that intensities are proportionally corrected.

text: In case of lamps equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources, the light sources shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent from the average luminous flux of the light sources, and the measured luminous intensities shall be corrected proportionally for the difference between the average luminous flux and the applicable reference/objective luminous flux.
quote: shall be operated at a voltage or electrical current setting such that the actual luminous fluxes of the light sources do not deviate by more than 5 per cent
condition: Lamp is equipped with multiple replaceable UN approved light sources
test_case: Check flux of each light source is within 5 % of the average and intensities are proportionally corrected.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: On the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Measure HV intensity of both samples for each function and confirm it is not below the paragraph 5 minimum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: In no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum, specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
test_case: Scan the visible field of both samples and confirm no point exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
quote: be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified
test_case: Measure each grid point of the Annex 3 light distribution figure and confirm values meet minimum × percentage or the specified value.

text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
quote: Within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified
test_case: Measure intensity across the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles and confirm it is not below the specified minimum.

text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
quote: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
test_case: Evaluate the light distribution for local intensity variations against Annex 3 provisions.

text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit.
quote: it shall comply with the requirements for: (a) Maximum intensity if all lamps together are lit
condition: Function is provided by an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D"
test_case: Light both lamps together and confirm intensity does not exceed the maximum.

text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp, it shall comply with the requirements for minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
quote: (b) Minimum intensity if either lamp has failed.
condition: Function is provided by an assembly of two independent lamps marked "D"
test_case: Disable each lamp in turn and confirm the remaining lamp meets minimum intensity.

text: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
quote: An interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
condition: A function is provided by an interdependent lamp system
test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify photometric and colorimetric compliance.

text: If the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
quote: the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s)
condition: Rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system split between fixed and movable components
test_case: Test the specified interdependent lamps at all fixed positions of the movable component for outboard visibility, colour and photometry.

text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
quote: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities: Outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
condition: Lamp uses variable intensity control (e.g. R2/S2)
test_case: Operate the variable intensity control across its range and confirm intensities stay within paragraph 5 limits.

text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp: (a) for systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions: under night-time conditions; (b) for other systems: under standard conditions.
quote: Exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp
condition: Lamp uses variable intensity control (e.g. R2/S2)
test_case: Under night-time or standard conditions, confirm intensity does not exceed the steady-lamp maximum.

text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously and the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
quote: should be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H
condition: Rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp
test_case: Measure combined and position-only intensities within ±5° V / ±10° H and confirm ratio ≥5:1 at each point.

text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
quote: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
test_case: Verify luminous intensity tests followed the Annex 8 procedure.

text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function
test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function within its Annex 3 light distribution grid.

text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
quote: To check these colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied.
test_case: Verify colorimetric tests used the paragraph 4.8 test conditions.

text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
quote: Outside this field no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
test_case: Visually/colorimetrically inspect outside the grid field and confirm no sharp colour variation.

text: For lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
quote: for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp
condition: Lamp uses non-replaceable light sources
test_case: Confirm colour measurements were made with the LED sources installed in the lamp.

text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
quote: the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
condition: A lamp function uses different light source technologies
test_case: Measure colour separately for each light source technology and confirm compliance.

text: For rear position lamps of category R1 (steady), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd, a maximum luminous intensity of 1.7∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp or 8.5∙10^0 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", a standard light distribution according to Figure A3-I, and a minimum luminous intensity of 5∙10^-2 cd within the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1, as specified in Table 4.
quote: R1, MR or RM1 (steady) 4∙100 1.7∙101 8.5∙100 Figure A3-I Table A2-1 5∙10-2
condition: Rear position lamp is category R1 (steady intensity)
test_case: Measure both samples: HV ≥4 cd, max ≤17 cd (8.5 cd if "D"), Figure A3-I grid compliant, ≥0.05 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

text: For rear position lamps of category R2 (variable), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd, a maximum luminous intensity of 4.2∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp or 2.1∙10^1 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", a standard light distribution according to Figure A3-I, and a minimum luminous intensity of 5∙10^-2 cd within the angles of geometric visibility of Table A2-1, as specified in Table 4.
quote: R2 or RM2 (variable) 4∙100 4.2∙101 2.1∙101 Figure A3-I Table A2-1 5∙10-2
condition: Rear position lamp is category R2 (variable intensity)
test_case: Measure both samples: HV ≥4 cd, max ≤42 cd (21 cd if "D"), Figure A3-I grid compliant, ≥0.05 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

text: For rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps, a luminous intensity of up to 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted only below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
quote: a luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5°
condition: Rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp
test_case: Confirm intensities above the Table 4 maximum (up to 60 cd) occur only below 5° down.

text: The minimum luminous intensity of the rear position lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 4 (5∙10^-2 cd).
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility: See Table 4
test_case: Measure across Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles and confirm ≥0.05 cd.

text: The rear position lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Assess the rear position lamp against paragraph 4.6 failure provisions.

text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be red.
test_case: Measure chromaticity of the rear position lamp and confirm it lies within the red colour boundaries.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples per Table 7; all values within the stated limits.

text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 1.30∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-I and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility (Table A2-1) shall be 3∙10^-1 cd, as given in Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is category S1 (steady intensity)
test_case: Measure intensity in reference axis, standard light distribution points and geometric visibility field; verify ≥60 cd, ≤260 cd (≤130 cd if 'D'), and ≥0.3 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 3.65∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-I and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility (Table A2-1) shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (day) and 7∙10^-2 cd (night), as given in Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is category S2 (variable intensity)
test_case: Measure in day and night modes; verify ≥60 cd, ≤730 cd (≤365 cd if 'D'), and ≥0.3 cd day / ≥0.07 cd night within Table A2-1 angles.

text: For a stop lamp of category S3 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 2.5∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.10∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 5.5∙10^1 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-III and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility (Table A2-1) shall be 3∙10^-1 cd, as given in Table 7.
condition: Stop lamp is category S3
test_case: Measure per Figure A3-III; verify ≥25 cd, ≤110 cd (≤55 cd if 'D'), ≥0.3 cd within geometric visibility.

text: For a stop lamp of category S4 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 2.5∙10^1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 8.0∙10^1 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as defined in Figure A3-III and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility (Table A2-1) shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (day) and 7∙10^-2 cd (night), as given in Table 7.
quote: S4 (variable) 2.5∙101 1.60∙102 8.0∙101 Figure A3-III Table A2-1 3∙10-1 (day) 7∙10-2 (night)
condition: Stop lamp is category S4
test_case: Measure day and night modes per Figure A3-III; verify ≥25 cd, ≤160 cd (≤80 cd if 'D'), ≥0.3/0.07 cd within geometric visibility.

text: The minimum luminous intensity of the stop lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 7.
quote: Minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility See Table 7.
test_case: Measure intensity across the Table A2-1 geometric visibility field; verify values not below Table 7 minimum.

text: The stop lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Verify failure behaviour of the stop lamp against paragraph 4.6 provisions.

text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be red.
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of stop lamp light; chromaticity within red boundaries.

text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the reversing lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
quote: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both reversing lamp samples; all values within Table 10 limits.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 8.0∙10^1 cd, with the standard light distribution as defined in Figure A3-V, as given in Table 10.
test_case: Measure in reference axis and Figure A3-V points; verify minimum ≥80 cd per distribution.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity in or above the H-plane shall be 3.00∙10^2 cd, as given in Table 10.
test_case: Measure intensity in and above H-plane; verify ≤300 cd.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity below the H-plane, down to 5°D, shall be 6.00∙10^2 cd, as given in Table 10.
test_case: Measure intensity between H-plane and 5°D; verify ≤600 cd.

text: For a reversing lamp of category AR, the maximum luminous intensity below 5°D shall be 8.00∙10^3 cd, as given in Table 10.
test_case: Measure intensity below 5°D; verify ≤8000 cd.

text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied, and this condition shall be clearly explained in the application for approval.
quote: the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied
condition: Reversing lamp intended to be installed exclusively in a pair of devices
test_case: Measure intensity up to 30° inwards; verify ≥25 cd.

text: The reversing lamp shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
quote: Failure provisions: See paragraph 4.6.
test_case: Verify failure behaviour of the reversing lamp against paragraph 4.6 provisions.

text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
quote: Colour: The colour of light emitted shall be white.
test_case: Colorimetric measurement of reversing lamp light through the lens zone; chromaticity within white boundaries.

text: The rear position lamp (R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard (20°/80° reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm). It shall have minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 15° below (15°/5° for lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm; 5°/15° for optional lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm), as given in Table A2-1.
condition: Rear position lamp is approved as category R1 or R2 (not MR)
test_case: Measure the geometric visibility of the rear position lamp apparent surface on a goniometer and confirm it is unobstructed over at least 45°/80° horizontally and 15°/15° vertically, or the reduced angles applicable to the mounting height.

text: The stop lamp (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 45° outboard (20°/45° reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm). It shall have minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 15° below (15°/5° for lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm; 5°/15° for optional lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm), as given in Table A2-1.
condition: Stop lamp is approved as category S1 or S2 (not MS)
test_case: Measure the geometric visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface and confirm it is unobstructed over at least 45°/45° horizontally and 15°/15° vertically, or the reduced angles applicable to the mounting height.

text: The singular rear position lamp (MR) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 80° inboard / 80° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15°/5° for lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm), as given in Table A2-1.
quote: Front/rear position singular (MA, MR) 80°/80° 15°/10° (15°/5°) b
condition: Rear position lamp is approved as category MR, installed singularly
test_case: Verify on a goniometer that the apparent surface is visible over 80°/80° horizontally and 15°/10° vertically, or 15°/5° below 750 mm.

text: The rear position lamps (MR) installed as a pair shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 20° inboard / 80° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15°/5° for lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm), as given in Table A2-1.
quote: Front/rear position pair (MA, MR) 20°/80° 15°/10° (15°/5°) b
condition: Rear position lamp is approved as category MR, installed as a pair
test_case: Verify on a goniometer that the apparent surface is visible over 20°/80° horizontally and 15°/10° vertically, or 15°/5° below 750 mm.

text: The singular stop lamp (MS) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 45° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15°/5° for lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm), as given in Table A2-1.
condition: Stop lamp is approved as category MS, installed singularly
test_case: Verify on a goniometer that the apparent surface is visible over 45°/45° horizontally and 15°/10° vertically, or 15°/5° below 750 mm.

text: The stop lamps (MS) installed as a pair shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 0° inboard / 45° outboard and minimum vertical angles of 15° above / 10° below (15°/5° for lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm), as given in Table A2-1.
condition: Stop lamp is approved as category MS, installed as a pair
test_case: Verify on a goniometer that the apparent surface is visible over 0°/45° horizontally and 15°/10° vertically, or 15°/5° below 750 mm.

text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall meet, for the various directions of measurement relative to the reference axis (H = 0°, V = 0°, passing through the centre of reference), the minimum intensities given in Figures A3-I to A3-XV as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, mathematically rounded down to three significant digits, unless specified otherwise.
quote: the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement at each grid direction; each measured intensity ≥ the figure percentage × required minimum, rounded down to three significant digits.

text: Where the rear position lamp or the stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: in the case where one of the following lamps is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm
condition: Intended mounting height of the lamp ≤ 750 mm above ground (mounting position not stated).
test_case: Check manufacturer-declared mounting height; if ≤ 750 mm, verify that photometric compliance is demonstrated down to 5° below horizontal.

text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
quote: the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines
test_case: Scan intensities between grid points; each value ≥ the lowest minimum percentage on surrounding grid lines.

text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of the lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
quote: in the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made
test_case: Visually inspect reversing lamp; if local variations seen, measure between adjacent measurement directions and confirm ≥ 50% of the lower prescribed minimum.

text: The rear position lamps and stop lamps of category S1 or S2 shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, the values shown giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 4 and 7).
quote: The values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
test_case: Measure rear position and stop lamp intensities at Figure A3-I points; each ≥ given percentage of the table minimum.

text: The reversing lamp shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V, the values shown giving, for the various directions of measurement relative to the axis of reference, the minimum intensities in cd.
quote: The values shown in figure A3-V give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd.
test_case: Measure reversing lamp intensities at each Figure A3-V point; each ≥ the cd value shown.

text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences of the lamp do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
quote: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation
test_case: Compare mechanical and geometric features of randomly sampled production lamps with the approved type; pass if differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

text: With respect to photometric performance, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random, no measured value shall deviate from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
quote: when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random: (a) No measured value deviates
test_case: Measure photometric performance of randomly chosen production rear position, stop and reversing lamps per paragraph 4.8.; pass if no value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3.

text: In the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, if results of the photometric test do not meet the requirements, tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
quote: in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source and if results of the test described above do not meet the requirements
condition: The lamp is equipped with a replaceable light source.
test_case: If a lamp with replaceable light source fails photometry, repeat the photometric test with another standard light source and check compliance.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of the lamp shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of the red (position, stop) and white (reversing) light of sampled lamps under paragraph 4.9. conditions; pass if within the prescribed colour boundaries.

text: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
condition: Any lamp function (rear position, stop, reversing) uses incandescent light sources only
test_case: Operate the lamp until photometric stability and measure luminous intensities at all test points; all values must be within the minimum and maximum limits.

text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
test_case: Measure reversing lamp intensities after 1 min and after 10 min of operation (directly or by HV ratio scaling from the stabilised distribution); all points must be within the min/max limits.

text: For rear position lamps and stop lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
quote: For all other lamps, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either - after 30 minutes of operation, or - after photometric stability has occurred shall comply
test_case: Measure rear position and stop lamp intensities after 1 min and after 30 min or photometric stability (directly or by HV ratio scaling); all points must be within the min/max limits.

text: For the rear position lamp, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure HV intensity 4 s after switch ON and scale the distribution by the HV ratio; all test points must meet the rear position lamp min/max limits.

text: For the stop lamp, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure HV intensity 0.2 s after switch ON and scale the distribution by the HV ratio; all test points must meet the stop lamp min/max limits.

text: For the reversing lamp, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, using HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
quote: the luminous intensity distribution is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1.
test_case: Measure HV intensity 0.2 s after switch ON and scale the distribution by the HV ratio; all test points must meet the reversing lamp min/max limits.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, a lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time
test_case: Confirm all lamp functions use LED technology only and that measurements per paragraph 1.2 are compliant; additional time-point testing then not required.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance
condition: A lamp function uses a light generating technology other than incandescent or LED
test_case: Measure intensities from the Table A8-1 time point until photometric stability; all values must be within min/max limits.

text: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
quote: In case a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested following the strictest time requirements
condition: A lamp function uses more than one light generating technology
test_case: Apply the strictest time requirements of 2.1.1 to 2.1.3 and verify intensities comply with min/max limits.

text: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
quote: In case of doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of a lamp (function) are tested and checked for compliance at all points in time
test_case: If run-up behaviour is doubtful, continuously measure intensity from the Table A8-1 time point to photometric stability; minimum values must be met throughout.

text: A separate approval is required for each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1 (the retro-reflector of Class IA or IB).
quote: A separate approval is required for each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1.
test_case: Check that the integrated retro-reflector has its own R150 approval, separate from the lamp functions' approvals.

text: The approval number assigned to the approved type of retro-reflector shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
quote: An approval number shall be assigned to each type approved and shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
test_case: Inspect the device and verify that the assigned approval number is marked in line with paragraph 3.3.

text: Every retro-reflective device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
quote: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement
test_case: Inspect drawings and samples to verify a marking space large enough for the UI or the approval marking plus the paragraph 3.3.4.2 markings.

text: All markings on the retro-reflective device shall be clearly legible and indelible.
quote: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
test_case: Visually inspect the markings and perform a rub/durability check; the markings must remain clearly legible.

text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1 (minimum 5 mm for retro-reflectors of Class IA or IB).
quote: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” is defined in Table 1.
test_case: Measure the approval mark and verify that dimension "a" is at least 5 mm.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
quote: The approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
condition: Approval marking used instead of Unique Identifier
test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle enclosing "E" and the approving country number.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
quote: The four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
condition: Approval marking used instead of Unique Identifier
test_case: Inspect the marking for the 4- to 6-digit sequential number of the approval.

text: The sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
quote: This sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
condition: Approval marking used instead of Unique Identifier
test_case: Verify by inspection that the sequential number is adjacent to the E-circle.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5 (IA or IB).
quote: The symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
condition: Approval marking used instead of Unique Identifier; Class IA (independent) or IB (combined with non-watertight lamps) to be confirmed
test_case: Inspect the marking for the correct class symbol (IA or IB) as per Table 1.

text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
quote: The number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force
condition: Approval marking used instead of Unique Identifier
test_case: Inspect the marking for "150R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments.

text: If the approval marking is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
quote: The Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown below
condition: Unique Identifier used instead of approval marking
test_case: Compare the UI mark on the device against the Figure I format.

text: The retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
test_case: Inspect the device for the applicant's trade name or mark.

text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA or IB, the retro-reflective device shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
quote: the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity
condition: TOP indication needed to determine the angle(s) of rotation without ambiguity
test_case: If rotation is restricted, verify that "TOP" is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4 shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
quote: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
test_case: Visually inspect the device to confirm the approval marking/UI, trade name and TOP marking are clearly legible.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the marking shall be visible after their installation.
quote: This marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that: It is visible after their installation.
condition: A single approval mark is used for the combined lamp and retro-reflector
test_case: Install the lamp on a representative vehicle or fixture and verify that the single approval mark remains visible.

text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
quote: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark
condition: A single approval mark is used for the combined lamp and retro-reflector
test_case: Review the construction to confirm that every light-transmitting part cannot be removed without removing the single approval mark.

text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
quote: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks
condition: A single approval mark is used for the combined lamp and retro-reflector
test_case: Measure the single approval mark components and compare them against the smallest minimum size required by the applicable Regulations.

text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulation No. 48, and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval, shall apply to the retro-reflector where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied
test_case: Check the retro-reflector against the applicable UN R48 sections 5 and 6 provisions for M1 vehicles that can be verified at component approval; all must be met.

text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector and review the results of all Annex 6/7 tests; it must function satisfactorily throughout.

text: The retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
quote: they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition
test_case: Visually inspect the samples; there must be no design or manufacturing defect affecting operation or maintenance.

text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector by hand without tools; the components must not separate easily.

text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
test_case: Inspect the outer lens surface over the retro-reflector; it must be easy to clean.

text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
test_case: Inspect the outer surface by sight and touch; it must not be rough and any protuberances must not prevent cleaning.

text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp; the inner surface of the retro-reflector must not be accessible in normal use.

text: If the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the unit and filter must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated
condition: The retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter (e.g. red-tinted outer lens acting as filter).
test_case: Inspect the construction; the optical unit and filter must not be separable under normal conditions of use.

text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.
test_case: Review the BOM and inspect the optical unit and filter; their colouring must not come from paint or varnish.

text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
quote: the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0°
test_case: Perform the colour measurement with Illuminant A at 1/3° divergence and β1=β2=0°, or at the Annex 4 angle; confirm the test conditions are recorded.

text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflective device shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates; they must lie within the UN R48 red night-time colour limits.

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5
test_case: Measure the shape and dimensions of the retro-reflector; they must comply with Annex 5 (e.g. non-triangular shape).

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
test_case: Perform photometric and colorimetric measurements; the results must meet paragraphs 5.1.4 and 5.1.5.

text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
quote: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction
test_case: Carry out the physical and mechanical tests of paragraph 5.1.7; all must be passed.

text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and, at least one hour after this test, examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
quote: the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined
test_case: Run the Annex 6 Part 1 heat test on the ten samples and measure colour and RI at 20' and 0°/0° at least one hour later; they must meet 5.1.4 and 5.1.5.

text: The two samples of the first group of retro-reflectors shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
quote: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then
test_case: Perform the water penetration test, then the fuel and lubricant resistance tests on group 1; the samples must pass.

text: The two samples of the second group of retro-reflectors shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
quote: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6
test_case: Perform the corrosion test (if applicable) and the rear-face abrasion test on group 2; the samples must pass.

text: The two samples of the third group of retro-reflectors shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
quote: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties
test_case: Perform the Annex 4 Part 3 stability-in-time test on group 3; the samples must pass.

text: The two samples of the fourth group of retro-reflectors shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
quote: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 6 weathering test on group 4; the samples must pass.

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
quote: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have: A colour which satisfies
test_case: Measure the colour of each group after testing; it must meet paragraph 5.1.5.

text: After undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group must have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
quote: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4. The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20'
test_case: Measure RI at 20' divergence and 0°/0° for each group after testing; it must meet paragraph 5.1.4.

text: Where more than one axis of reference, or a range of axes of reference, is specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements of the retro-reflector shall be repeated, making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
quote: the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis
condition: The manufacturer specifies more than one axis of reference or a range of axes.
test_case: Repeat the photometry for each specified axis or the extreme axes of the range; each set must meet Table 3.

text: For photometric measurements of the Class IA or IB retro-reflector, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system, as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter, shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2.
quote: contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2
test_case: Verify that the measured illuminating surface lies within a 200 mm circle and does not exceed 100 cm2.

text: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area of the retro-reflector to be used for photometric measurements.
quote: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used.
test_case: Check that the drawings define the perimeter of the photometric area.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB at an angle of divergence of 20' shall be equal to or greater than 3.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°/β2 = 0°, 2.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°/β2 = 0°, and 1.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°/β2 = ±20°, as given in Table 3.
quote: the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux
test_case: Goniophotometric measurement at 20' divergence; RI must be ≥300 at 0°/0°, ≥200 at ±10°/0° and ≥100 at ±5°/±20° mcd/lx.

text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB at an angle of divergence of 1°30' shall be equal to or greater than 5 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°/β2 = 0°, 2.8 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°/β2 = 0°, and 2.5 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°/β2 = ±20°, as given in Table 3.
test_case: Measure at 1°30' divergence; RI must be ≥5 at 0°/0°, ≥2.8 at ±10°/0° and ≥2.5 at ±5°/±20° mcd/lx.

text: RI values of the retro-reflector lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the lines (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
quote: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference
test_case: Scan RI within the defined solid angle; no value may fall below the corresponding Table 3 minimum.

text: Where the Class IA or Class IB retro-reflector is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
quote: is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to
condition: Mounting height of the retro-reflector H plane on the vehicle is less than 750 mm.
test_case: If the mounting height is <750 mm, verify the RI values down to 5° below horizontal only; they must meet Table 3.

text: The testing of the colour for the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
quote: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
test_case: Confirm the colour test report follows the 4.2.1 method.

text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector must be within the limits for the night-time colour red as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the reflected light; they must lie within the UN R48 red night-time limits.

text: The retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the tests in the chronological order given in Table 4 (Chronological order of tests, Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB).
quote: Chronological order of tests Table 4 Chronological order of tests (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB)
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Review the test report and confirm the samples a to j were tested in the sequence and allocation of Table 4.

text: The retro-reflector samples of Classes IA and IB shall meet the general specifications and the shapes and dimensions of Annex 5 by visual inspection, as listed in Table 4.
quote: General specifications: visual inspection x x x x x x x x x x Annex 5 Shapes and dimensions: visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Visually inspect all ten samples against paragraph 4 and Annex 5; pass if no non-conformity is found.

text: The retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall withstand the heat test according to Part 1 of Annex 6 (48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C) without distortion on visual inspection.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 6 Heat: 48 h at 65° ± 2°C Visual inspection for distortion
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Expose the samples for 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C and visually inspect; pass if no distortion is visible.

text: After the heat test, the retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall meet the colorimetry requirements of paragraph 4.2. (visual inspection, trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt) and the photometry requirements of Part 1 of Annex 4 limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°, with complete photometry on the designated samples.
quote: Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: visual inspection Trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Measure colour and the coefficient of luminous intensity at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° (and complete photometry on two samples); pass if within the required limits.

text: The retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall withstand the water test according to Part 3 of Annex 6 (10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position) followed by visual inspection, colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 3 of Annex 6 Water: 10 min. in normal position 10 min. in inverted position visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Immerse the samples 10 min normal and 10 min inverted, inspect, then check colour and photometry; pass if no water ingress and the values are met.

text: The retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall withstand the motor fuels test according to Part 1 of Annex 7 (5 min) on visual inspection.
quote: Part 1 of Annex 7 Motor fuels: 5 min. visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Expose the samples to motor fuel for 5 min and visually inspect; pass if no visible deterioration.

text: The retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall withstand the oils test according to Part 2 of Annex 7 (5 min) on visual inspection, followed by colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 2 of Annex 7 Oils: 5 min. visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Expose the samples to lubricating oil for 5 min, inspect, then check colour and photometry; pass if no deterioration and the values are met.

text: The retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall withstand the corrosion test according to Part 4 of Annex 6 (24 hours, 2 hours interval, 24 hours) on visual inspection.
quote: Part 4 of Annex 6 Corrosion: 24 hours 2 hours interval 24 hours visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Perform salt-spray exposure 24 h + 2 h interval + 24 h and visually inspect; pass if no corrosion that impairs performance.

text: The retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall withstand the rear face test according to Part 4 of Annex 6 (1 min) on visual inspection, followed by colorimetry and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 4 of Annex 6 Rear face: 1 min. visual inspection
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated)
test_case: Apply the rear-face test for 1 min, inspect, then check colour and photometry; pass if no damage and the values are met.

text: The retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall meet the stability in time test according to Part 3 of Annex 4, followed by colorimetry according to paragraph 4.2. and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 3 of Annex 4 Stability in time Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: Visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB and the test is not omitted under paragraph 5.1.6.
test_case: Perform the stability-in-time test, then check colour and photometry; pass if the values remain within the required limits.

text: The retro-reflector of Classes IA and IB shall meet the resistance to weathering test according to Part 6 of Annex 6, followed by colorimetry according to paragraph 4.2. and photometry limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
quote: Part 6 of Annex 6 Resistance to weathering Par. 4.2. Colorimetry: Visual inspection or trichromatic coordinates
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB and the test is not omitted under paragraph 5.1.6.
test_case: Perform the weathering exposure, then check colour and photometry; pass if the values remain within the required limits.

text: With respect to photometric performance of mass-produced retro-reflective devices, no measured value of any retro-reflective device chosen at random shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
quote: No measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
test_case: Measure the photometric values (CIL) of a randomly chosen production retro-reflector and confirm that no value is more than 20 % below the prescribed minimum.

text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be complied with.
quote: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.
test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of a randomly chosen production retro-reflector and confirm that they lie within the prescribed red colour boundaries.

text: One of the retro-reflectors of sample A, after the sampling procedure in paragraph 2., shall be tested for resistance to water penetration according to the procedure described in paragraph 1. of Part 2 of Annex 6 and shall pass the test; if the test on sample A is not complied with, both retro-reflective devices of sample B shall pass the same procedure.
quote: One of the retro-reflectors of sample A after the sampling procedure in paragraph 2. shall be tested according to the procedure described in paragraph 1. of Part 2 of Annex 6
test_case: Subject a production retro-reflector sample to the Annex 6 Part 2 paragraph 1 water penetration test and confirm that it passes, or that both sample B devices pass if the first fails.

text: When the RI of the retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device; if there is any such effect, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
quote: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced
test_case: Turn the device slightly at β1 = β2 = 0° on the goniometer; if a mirror effect occurs, verify that a reading at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° is taken and recorded.

text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
quote: retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified
condition: Retro-reflector is not marked "TOP"
test_case: Rotate the device about its reference axis at β = 0° and 20' divergence, find the minimum RI position, and verify the RI meets the paragraph 5 value.

text: When the RI of a retro-reflective device not marked "TOP" is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to the value of ε of minimum RI; if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
quote: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε.
condition: Retro-reflector is not marked "TOP"
test_case: Measure RI at all other specified angles with the device fixed at the minimum-RI ε position (±5° allowed) and verify all values meet the specified limits.

text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5° and the RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
quote: retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°. The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position
condition: Retro-reflector is marked "TOP"
test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked device ±5° about its reference axis at β = 0° and 20' divergence and verify RI never falls below the prescribed value.

text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI of the retro-reflective device exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
quote: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements
test_case: Measure RI at β = 0°, ε = 0°; if it is ≥150 % of the specified value, verify all further measurements are made at ε = 0° and meet the limits.

text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
quote: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A
test_case: Verify the test report shows illumination with CIE Standard Illuminant A and measurement per Annex 4 Part 1.

text: The measuring distance for photometry of the retro-reflective device shall be chosen such that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η are respected, but not lower than 10 m.
quote: The measuring distance shall be chosen in such an order that at least the limits for the angles δ, γ and η given above
test_case: Check the test set-up records a measuring distance of at least 10 m with δ ≤ 10', γ ≤ 10' and η ≤ 80'.

text: For retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB, the shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
condition: Retro-reflector is approved as Class IA or IB (class not stated in specification)
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m and confirm it cannot be easily confused with the triangular shape of Class IIIA/IIIB retro-reflectors.

text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices of Classes IA, IB, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C
condition: Retro-reflector is a moulded plastics reflector of Class IA or IB
test_case: Condition the retro-reflector 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C dry, cool 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C, and confirm test conditions were met before inspection.

text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.
test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after the heat test; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion of the device or optical component is visible.

text: The retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water; this test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, and the device shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes
test_case: Immerse the stripped retro-reflector 10 min at 50 °C ± 5 °C 20 mm below surface, repeat inverted, then immerse at 25 °C ± 5 °C; verify conditions recorded.

text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
test_case: After the water immersion test, visually inspect the reflecting surface; pass if no water is present.

text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
